name: logistic_regression_cv
desc: Federated K-fold cross-validation for logistic regression with one-hot encoded categorical covariates.
label: Logistic Regression Cross-validation

y.label: Dependent variable (binary)
y.desc: A unique nominal variable. The variable is converted to binary by assigning 1 to the positive class and 0 to all other classes.

x.label: Covariates (independent)
x.desc: One or more covariates (numerical or categorical). Categorical variables are one-hot encoded.

positive_class.label: Positive class (y=1)
positive_class.desc: Positive class of y. All other classes are considered negative.

n_splits.label: Number of folds
n_splits.desc: Number of folds for K-fold cross-validation.
